nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness measures estimated by FreeSurfer version 5.3 or 6.0 over 148 cortical regions in the Destrieux atlas were used as the response variable for normative modeling.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: In our analyses, we use cortical thickness measures estimated by Freesurfer version 5.3 or 6.0 over 148 cortical regions in the Destrieux atlas
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Kia2022.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Datasets and preprocessing

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age was used as the primary covariate (explanatory variable) for modeling the normative trajectory. Sex was used as a group-effect in all estimated models. Scanner/site was also included as a group-effect in the HBR models to account for site-effects in multi-center data.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: In all experimental configurations, we use only age as a covariate except for the fixed-effect site modeling in which, by definition, the one-hot encoding of scanner ids are also included in the covariates. We use sex as a group-effect in all estimated models. In the HBR case, the scanner is also included as a group-effect.
